div.p: A type interns VALUES keyed by a column tuple. A rel interns NAMES keyed by (parent_id, local_name, arity).
The rel side needs ONE thing the type side never did: a per-file disambiguator. Two FILES can carry one rel name; two variants in one file cannot.

div.h2: the one way to get it wrong
div.p: Put h_schema in the NAME, and one added column renames the table:
A rename in SQLite is a new empty table. The old rows sit in a name nothing will ever ask for again.
So the hash is a COLUMN of __rel, and the name stays boring.
